state_messages.reasoning_content:
The question: "When was the person who was the first viceroy of the British Empire in India impeached?"

The first Viceroy of India was Warren Hastings? No, Warren Hastings was Governor-General. The first Viceroy was actually... The title "Viceroy" was formally used from 1858 after the Government of India Act 1858. The first person to hold the title of Viceroy and Governor-General of India was Charles Canning (Lord Canning), in 1858.

But impeachment? Warren Hastings was the first Governor-General of Bengal (1773), and he was impeached in 1788. Hmm, but the question says "first viceroy of the British Empire in India."
